posts.zh:
dsh-unread-dot 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。macOS Dock 角标与提示音：最小化/切走时 Dock 显示未读角标（运行中=红点、跑完=数字）并播放水泡提示音，回到应用自动清除，基于 Badging API。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-21b79edd86202ef4b9ea.html
posts.en:
dsh-unread-dot is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. macOS Dock badge and bubble chime: shows an unread badge on the Dock (dot while running, count when done) and plays a chime while the app is hidden; clears on return, built on the Badging API.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-21b79edd86202ef4b9ea.html
